decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor still fits the firm's modular sensing portfolio well, though as a somewhat specialized hardware module its withdrawal risk is moderately higher after several years on the market.
As a newer-generation replacement in a core measurement category, the voltage measurement module is likely to remain a supported building block of the platform.
The MQTT software proxy broadens connectivity for many users at low maintenance cost, so it is strategically attractive to keep available.
The CAN bus interface remains a sensible product for industrial, automation, and robotics use cases, although its narrower audience gives it some retirement risk.
The carbon dioxide sensor module serves relevant education, lab, and building-monitoring applications, but as a more specialized sensor it carries a somewhat elevated discontinuation risk over time.
The touch panel accessory is the most optional and least central of the products, so it has the highest withdrawal risk even though it still complements control and prototyping projects.
